### 1. Section of Document
*Which section does this amendment or feedback pertain to? (e.g., Detailed Design 2.1, Production Gotchas Path 2, Appendix A.4)*

### 2. Nature of Feedback
- [ ] Statutory reference amendment (US IRC or India Income-tax Act)
- [ ] Custodian policy / DP procedure update (Schwab, Fidelity, Vanguard, Empower)
- [ ] Cross-border treaty or reporting clarification (DTAA, Form 1040-NR, Form 8606, Schedule FA)
- [ ] Math / Calculation nuance
- [ ] Other

### 3. Proposed Change or Correction
*Describe the proposed change clearly.*

### 4. Primary Statutory or Regulatory Citation
*Include link to irs.gov, law.cornell.edu, incometaxindia.gov.in, or official custodian forms.*
